Introduction
This document outlines procedures P1, 
 which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block.
The efficiency of the battery should be calculated during 
 partial discharging of the battery. The rated capacity of the battery, the 
 charge and discharge characteristics should be available.
The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Abdallah Elsayed M, and revised by EDEPC quality 
 control eng. Adel Abd EL kader El Nagar, accepted by eng El 
 Sayed Attiah and approved by eng. Awad Soliman Head Sector of Talkha 
PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
No 
 smoking is permitted in battery room.
Wear 
 standard personal safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, rubber gloves, ... etc.
Use 
 the proper insulated tools.
